title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as F = 3Mg.

title: Distance traveled
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as L = v₀²/(4g).

title: Force analysis and acceleration
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to find the constant acceleration (a = -2g) using the net force (Mg - F).

title: Motional EMF derivation
description: Important: Correctly formulates the induced EMF as E = B₂ * d * v, using the magnetic field in the lower region.

title: Circuit voltage relationship
description: Important: Correctly applies Kirchhoff's law or Ohm's law to relate output voltage U, induced EMF E, and current I (U + E = IR).

title: Energy output integration
description: Important: Correctly sets up and integrates the power (P=U*I) over time to find the total energy output W.

title: Energy recovery identification
description: Optional: For part (6), identifies that the recoverable energy comes from the system's initial mechanical energy (kinetic + gravitational potential).

title: Sign error in force/acceleration
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in the equation of motion (e.g., Mg + F = Ma) leading to wrong acceleration and subsequent answers.

title: Magnetic field confusion
description: Pitfall: Using the wrong magnetic field (B₁ instead of B₂) for calculating the motional EMF or the Ampere force.

title: Unit or constant mishandling
description: Pitfall: Failing to correctly substitute the given expression for d (d = 3Mg/(kI²)) and the relation B₁ = kI to simplify results.
